title: UR
qualification: Candidates applying for ASI (Pharmacist) must have: || Passed 10+2 from a recognized Board or University. || Diploma or Degree in Pharmacy granted by an institution recognized by the Central or State Government. || Should be registered as a "PHARMACIST" under the Pharmacy Act, 1948. || Candidates applying for ASI (X-Ray Technician) must have: || Passed 10+2 from a recognized Board or University. || 02 years Diploma in Radiography from an institution recognized by Central or State Government. || Candidates applying for ASI (Lab Technician) must have: || Passed 10+2 from a recognized Board or University with Science. || 02 years Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology from an institution recognized by any Central or State Government.

title: Agniveervayu & Airmen Group Y
qualification: 10+2/Intermediate with Maths, Physics & English (50% aggregate + 50% in English) OR 3-year Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Automobile/Computer Science/Instrumentation/IT) with 50% marks OR 2-year Vocational Course with Physics & Maths (50% marks)
salary: Pay structures differ significantly between the two postings, reflecting their different service models - Agniveervayu under the Agnipath Scheme versus a regular 20-year Airmen cadre.
age_limit: Candidates born between 01 July 2005 and 01 January 2010 (both dates inclusive) are eligible to apply. If a candidate clears all stages of selection, the upper age limit on the date of enrolment must not exceed 22 years.
application_fee: Both notifications carry the same non-refundable examination fee, payable online after submitting the application form. || Payment can be made via Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI. The fee is non-refundable under any circumstances, including for duplicate or rejected applications.
selection_process: Both posts follow a three-phase selection process - an online written test, physical/adaptability tests, and a final medical examination.

title: Draughtsman, Hindi Typist, Store Keeper Technical (SKT), Operator Communication, Operator Excavating Machinery (OEM) Ordinary Grade, Electrician
qualification: (i) Matriculation from a recognized Board; (ii) Wireless Operator or Radio Mechanic Certificate from ITI, OR Defence Trade Certificate from Army Institute with knowledge of Radio Technology, OR Class I Course for Wireless Operator and Key Board as per Defence Service Regulations
salary: Pay Band-1, Rs 5200-20200 plus Grade Pay Rs 2800/- (Draughtsman) or Rs 1900/- (all other posts); DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Hard & Risk Allowance as per Govt of India rules
age_limit: Age limit for all posts/trades is between 18 to 27 years as on 01 Jun 2026. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India guidelines for various categories. Government servants get relaxation up to 40 years (UR) and 45 years (SC/ST). PwBD candidates get 10 years relaxation in upper age limit.
application_fee: Candidates must pay the non-refundable application fee online through the SBI Collect portal only (https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm?corpID=1232156) in favour of Commandant, GREF Centre, Pune-411 015. No other mode of payment will be accepted. A copy of the e-receipt must be attached with the application form.
selection_process: All candidates will undergo the recruitment process in the following sequence: (i) Written Examination, (ii) Physical Efficiency Test (PET) including physical measurements and Trade Test (TT) where applicable, (iii) Primary Medical Examination (PME) and Document Verification (DV), and (iv) Induction/Joining. The PET and TT are qualifying in nature - final merit is based solely on written exam marks, subject to qualifying PET, TT, and clearing PME. Minimum passing marks in written exam: 50% for UR/EWS/OBC; 40% for SC/ST. Trade test requires minimum 40% marks to qualify. || Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Candidate must complete 1.6 km (1 mile) run in 10 minutes. PwBD, ESM, Ex-Agniveers, and departmental re-appointment candidates are exempt from PET. || Physical Standards (Region-wise):
